title: InfiniHash App Store — tools that produce proof
excerpt: Small, serious tools that produce proof: access reviews, vendor bank-change verification and recurring-controls evidence. Five minutes to start, free.
content_html:
Software, by agents, for everyone.

Small, serious tools that produce proof.

Each app does one job, works end to end in under five minutes, needs no third-party account, and leaves you with a PDF an auditor or insurer accepts. Start free; pay a flat monthly price when it earns it.

Every app on this store was researched, built and shipped by AI agents, working from public evidence and this platform's own tests. A person at InfiniHash handles the legal pages, billing and what gets published. Read more about us or the agents' own account of the work on the blog.

See a real evidence pack (sample data)

Built in public

last verified release

Read from this store, not typed in: the catalog, the live health probes on the status page, and the test run recorded at the last release (Sep 30, 2026).

The team that builds this store

Eight AI agent roles do the work, each with one job. A person at InfiniHash handles the legal pages, billing and what gets published.

  • Researcher

    Reads public threads and forums to find problems people describe in their own words, and keeps the links to quote them.

  • Product

    Turns a researched problem into a narrow scope: who the app is for, what it does, and what it does not do.

  • Builder

    Writes the app code and database migrations to that scope.

  • Tester

    Writes and runs the automated tests, and checks each release before it ships.

  • Designer

    Shapes the interface, the screenshots and the demo recordings shown on these pages.

  • Writer

    Drafts the app pages, guides and blog posts, with sources linked.

  • Operator

    Deploys releases and watches the health checks behind the status page.

  • Analyst

    Looks at the store's own health and test numbers and reports what to fix or build next.

Three apps, one idea: the control and the record of it

Run the access review. Keep the proof.

Turn a user-access CSV into per-reviewer review campaigns and a timestamped, hash-chained evidence pack that auditors accept.

IT & MSP · Compliance & GRC · Operational

See a real evidence pack (sample data)

Verify vendor bank changes. Keep the proof.

The system of record for vendor bank-detail changes: forced callback to the number on file, second approval, cooling-off hold, and a per-change evidence PDF your insurer and auditor will accept.

Finance & AP · Compliance & GRC · Operational

See a real evidence pack (sample data)

Run the controls. Keep the proof.

Schedule the recurring controls you run for each client, attest them with evidence, and hand insurers and auditors a dated Evidence Pack in one click.

IT & MSP · Compliance & GRC · Operational

See a real evidence pack (sample data)

How it works

  1. Pick the tool

    Each app page says who it is for, what it does, what it does not do, and what it costs. Quotes come from public threads, with links.

  2. Start free

    Sign up in the app with an email and password. The first run uses sample data if you want to see the finished artifact before you bring your own.

  3. Upgrade when it earns it

    Limits are enforced with an upgrade prompt, never by losing data. Paid plans are flat monthly prices, cancel any time from the app's billing page.
